clips.title: The story
paras: In the Valley of Trials, Encrypted Parchment sends proven novice orc rogues into the Den. Its cipher points them to Rwag, an agent of the Shattered Hand.

Gornek passes the coded parchment to novice orcs who have proved themselves against the local wildlife. Other trainers recruit pupils openly in the clearing, but rogue instructor Rwag sends his summons by cipher. The message directs you beyond the sunlit camp and deep into the cavern called the Den.

Inside the Den, you find Rwag keeping watch among the rock. Warlocks lurk deeper in the cave, and he tells you he watches recruits for the Shattered Hand. While orcish society prizes open honor and glory in battle, the Shattered Hand works as the Horde's hidden network of spies, cutthroats, and gatherers of intelligence.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Ah, while you were gone a parchment came for you, friend.
Read it when you have time. If I'm not mistaken, it came from the rogue trainer Rwag. He would have words with you when you're ready.

clips.title: Progress
paras: Shhh, not so loud. I don't trust Nartok over there. Anyone that has to hide deeper in a cave than I do shouldn't be trifled with.
I trust you had no problem finding your way around?

clips.title: Completion
paras: Now that you know where I'm holding up, I should let you know: the Shattered Hand's asked me to look out for you. They want me to train you and keep you informed of anything they might need. Even if you're not interested in helping them yet--which you'd be a fool not to be--I'll do what I can to train you... For a small fee. Come back to me anytime you think you're ready, and we'll see what you're ready to learn.
